AGENTS.md

Source: AGENTS.md

R package rfm (CRAN): recency / frequency / monetary customer segmentation. Standard R package layout.

Branches

  • Development happens on develop; releases are merged to master.
  • CI (R-CMD-check, coverage via codecov) runs on both branches.

Common commands

devtools::test()                          # all tests
devtools::test(filter = "rfm-plots")      # one file: tests/testthat/test-rfm-plots.R
devtools::document()                      # regenerate man/*.Rd from roxygen
devtools::build_readme()                  # README.md is generated from README.Rmd
rcmdcheck::rcmdcheck()                    # pre-CRAN check; target is 0 errors/warnings/notes
pkgdown::build_site()                     # site config in _pkgdown.yml

Documentation rules

  • Edit roxygen comments in R/*.R; never edit man/*.Rd directly (generated).
  • Edit README.Rmd, never README.md.
  • Docs use roxygen2 Markdown syntax.
  • Add user-facing changes as a bullet at the top of NEWS.md under “rfm (development version)”.
  • Follow the tidyverse style guide; do not restyle code unrelated to your change.

Testing quirks

  • testthat edition 3 (Config/testthat/edition: 3 in DESCRIPTION).
  • All plot tests use skip_on_cran(), so they only run locally/CI — run them locally before pushing; CRAN never exercises them.
  • Static ggplot plots are verified with vdiffr SVG snapshots in tests/testthat/_snaps/rfm-plots/. If you intentionally change plot output, update snapshots (vdiffr::manage_cases() or delete the SVG and re-run the test).
  • Plotly tests assert on plotly object internals (p$x$attrs[[...]]) plus expect_snapshot for hover text (tests/testthat/_snaps/rfm-plotly.md).
  • Legacy tests/figs/ SVGs are stale artifacts from an older vdiffr location; ignore them — _snaps/ is authoritative.
  • Shared fixtures (analysis_date, rfm_result, segments) are built at file top-level in test files from the bundled dataset rfm_data_orders.

Architecture notes

  • Each user-facing rfm_plot_*() takes an interactive = TRUE argument that switches the engine: static ggplot2 implementations live in R/rfm-ggplot.R (+ R/rfm-animate.R for animate = TRUE via gganimate), interactive plotly implementations in R/rfm-plotly.R. Dispatch happens inside R/rfm-plots.R.
  • Core scoring entrypoints: rfm_table_order() (transaction data) in R/rfm-table-transaction.R; rfm_table_customer() / rfm_table_customer_2() in R/rfm-table-customer*.R; segmentation in R/rfm-segment.R.
  • rfm_create_report() knits inst/template/rfm_report.Rmd; the Shiny app is launched with rfm_launch_app().
  • Bundled data: data/rfm_data_orders.rda, data/rfm_data_customer.rda (documented in R/rfm-data.R).
  • .onAttach makes a network call (available.packages()) in interactive sessions to check for updates — keep in mind when testing startup behavior.
